title: Korean Fried Pepper Skillet
description: A spicy and savory skillet dish featuring crispy fried peppers in a Korean-inspired sauce.

ingredients.name: oil
ingredients.notes: such as vegetable or peanut oil

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the peppers and cook, turning occasionally, until crisp and slightly charred, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the peppers to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil, garlic, and ginger. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the gochujang and soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the peppers to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the peppers are well coated.
Sprinkle with sugar, if using, and green onions.
